## Rationale

It is one record shown in two views. No idea is hidden, and each view lists everything that matches its field.

## Counter-argument

The same idea appears twice, so a count can mislead, and an action in one view must update the other.

payload.alternatives: show it under the effort only
payload.choice: Show an idea in both the area view and the effort backlog
